missing_units.reason: The visibility business-logic unit closes stewardship authority, parent binding, cycle checks and history mutation, but its evidence does not examine database work. DAL:1921-1961 traverses visibility-condition rows using recursive UNION ALL, joins descendants again on each level and applies DISTINCT only to final output; condition rows can represent multiple answers/groups for a parent-child relation. DAL:1964-2008 then enumerates affected specifications and reloads their visibility state individually, all within the visibility replacement transaction at :2013-2083. Trace whether accepted graph multiplicity and persisted graph size can amplify work beyond intended stewardship scope, considering route area-author authorization, schema caps at _schemas.ts:33-55, cycle validation, the depth-100 predicate, shared SQL pool/request timeouts and rollback/cancellation. The existing report-diff and cleanup availability units cover different computations. Intentional cross-specification propagation alone is not a defect, and actual SQL execution cost or shared availability impact remains a runtime/deployment validation fact; no target execution or stress testing is requested here.
